_comment: Release freeze for apps that keep state in their install dir ($APP).
Until the fleet runs a pilotctl with the app-state fix (install/upgrade carry $APP state forward),
the hourly `pilotctl appstore upgrade --all` on older nodes DELETES an app's saved state when the
catalogue publishes an update for it (the wallet's EVM key and data.db, smol's secrets.json,
per-app identity.json). catalogue/lint (the catalogue-lint CI job) therefore fails any PR that
updates an app listed here, or any app whose bundle manifest grants fs.write or key.sign.
To ship one anyway, add {id, version, reason, approved_by} to approved_bumps (reviewed in the PR),
or apply the PR label catalogue:stateful-bump-approved. See catalogue/README.md.
